recomputed_summary.scope: End-to-end per request: tokenizer, all windows ORT CPU synchronous inference, exhaustive decoding. Excludes model load, JSON evidence serialization and quality artifact verification. Report load separately. Single caller, no TTFT/decode-token claims.

review.synchronization: Synchronous ORT CPU Session.run; no asynchronous device synchronization is missing.
review.timing: Outer perf_counter encloses runtime.predict: tokenizer, every window, logit conversion and exhaustive span decode. Warmup/loading/evidence writes are outside request timing.
review.excluded: Quality evidence verification, threshold serving gate, later risk-head inference, I/O/network, concurrency and service queueing are not benchmarked.
review.rss: Darwin ru_maxrss is treated as bytes; lifetime peak includes interpreter, tokenizer, ORT initialization and inference. Not model-only allocation, resident steady state, file bytes or logical KV bytes.
review.provenance_limit: Workers do not individually snapshot runtime sources or OS PIDs. Parent sequential subprocess calls plus saved command order establish intended isolation; recorded clean tracked source state and Git content match protocol. This is not an external process trace.
review.generalization: Three processes per precision, eight fixed published single-window calibration requests on one Mac; no tail SLO, concurrent throughput, long-window risk, energy or cross-device claim. Speed does not override failed quality evaluation.

rc3_preservation.method: Independently compute Git blob SHA1 over header plus current bytes and compare RC3 tree; also record current SHA256. New result paths are outside this historical set.
